evidenceSummary.excerpt: Just as there were several theories concerning the origin of the world, so there were various accounts of the creation of man.
The first natural belief of the Greek people was that man had sprung from the earth.
In the course of time these primitive human beings became tamed and civilized by the gods and heroes, who taught them to work in metals, to build houses, and other useful arts of civilization.
By the command of his father, Deucalion built a ship, in which he and his wife took refuge during the deluge, which lasted for nine days.
After the lapse of time the theory of Autochthony (from _autos_, self, and _chthon_, earth) was laid aside.
